author: CBR
description:
Owen Harris breaks down what kind of knight Dunk might become in A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, and how his relationship with Egg changes both characters. In this Heroes Journey clip, Harris explains how Dunk’s own past as a squire shapes the responsibility he now has toward Egg, who is far from a normal squire.
